question.text: Can DXA (dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry) help identify lipedema fat distribution?
question.text_pt: A DXA (densitometria) ajuda a identificar a distribuição de gordura do lipedema?
question.current_answer: Based on currently indexed evidence, DXA can quantify the leg-predominant fat distribution of lipedema and regional fat indices may help discriminate clinically diagnosed lipedema from controls, but DXA is not a validated standalone diagnostic test. DISCRIMINATION: cross-sectional case-control studies converge on a peripheral fat pattern with preserved lean mass and bone density. Leg fat mass relative to total fat mass discriminated lipedema from controls across BMI strata (AUC 0.90; sensitivity 0.95, specificity 0.73 at cutoff 0.383; low grade); BMI-adjusted leg fat was about 1.3 times higher in lipedema, with leg fat/BMI the best discriminator (AUC 0.82 at cutoff 0.4637, sensitivity 87%, specificity 68%; low grade); in 72 women a lower trunk-to-leg fat ratio best distinguished lipedema from general obesity (AUC 0.964) and total fat of 43.5% or more separated it from familial partial lipodystrophy (AUC 0.990; moderate grade); and a small exploratory matched subset (n=12) found a composite distribution index differing from BMI-matched controls (g=1.26; low grade). Reviews repeat these cutoffs as auxiliary tools for borderline cases. LIMITATIONS: two moderate-grade reviews (32 studies, 1154 patients; 13 quantification tools) conclude that overall imaging diagnostic performance for lipedema is limited, with small heterogeneous samples, poorly documented protocols and rarely reported reliability, preventing recommendations. SPECIFICITY IN THE GENERAL POPULATION: a very-low-grade review warns that a gynoid fat phenotype can mimic lipedema, and a new NHANES 2011-2018 analysis of 4,986 women (one study, low grade) found that 57% met the 0.383 leg/total fat cutoff, far above the estimated 10-12% clinical prevalence of lipedema; since NHANES had no clinical lipedema assessment, this indicates that the cutoff, applied outside a clinical case-control setting, mostly captures a broader gynoid fat pattern rather than lipedema. PROXY USE: NHANES analyses of DXA-defined lipedema-like phenotypes report lower HOMA-IR (44.2%) and lower diabetes prevalence (OR 0.21), but these are exploratory, unvalidated proxies that describe a fat distribution, not diagnosed lipedema. Other studies use DXA only descriptively (a case report; a 40-patient kinesiophobia study with no fat-mass difference). Cutoffs come from single-centre studies and have not been validated externally against clinical diagnosis.
question.current_answer_pt: Com base nas evidências indexadas até o momento, a DXA consegue quantificar a distribuição de gordura predominante nas pernas típica do lipedema, e índices regionais de gordura podem ajudar a diferenciar o lipedema diagnosticado clinicamente de controles, mas a DXA não é um teste diagnóstico isolado validado. DISCRIMINAÇÃO: estudos transversais caso-controle convergem para um padrão periférico de gordura, com massa magra e densidade óssea preservadas. A massa gorda das pernas em relação à massa gorda total diferenciou lipedema de controles em todas as faixas de IMC (AUC 0,90; sensibilidade 0,95 e especificidade 0,73 no ponto de corte 0,383; grau baixo); a gordura das pernas ajustada pelo IMC foi cerca de 1,3 vez maior no lipedema, sendo a razão gordura das pernas/IMC o melhor discriminador (AUC 0,82 no ponto de corte 0,4637, sensibilidade 87%, especificidade 68%; grau baixo); em 72 mulheres, uma razão gordura do tronco/gordura das pernas mais baixa foi a que melhor separou lipedema de obesidade geral (AUC 0,964), e gordura total de 43,5% ou mais separou-o da lipodistrofia parcial familiar (AUC 0,990; grau moderado); e um pequeno subgrupo exploratório pareado (n=12) encontrou um índice composto de distribuição diferente do de controles pareados por IMC (g=1,26; grau baixo). Revisões repetem esses pontos de corte como ferramentas auxiliares em casos limítrofes. LIMITAÇÕES: duas revisões de grau moderado (32 estudos, 1154 pacientes; 13 ferramentas de quantificação) concluem que o desempenho diagnóstico geral dos exames de imagem no lipedema é limitado, com amostras pequenas e heterogêneas, protocolos mal documentados e confiabilidade raramente relatada, o que impede recomendações. ESPECIFICIDADE NA POPULAÇÃO GERAL: uma revisão de grau muito baixo alerta que um fenótipo ginoide pode imitar o lipedema, e uma nova análise do NHANES 2011-2018 com 4.986 mulheres (estudo único, grau baixo) verificou que 57% atingiam o ponto de corte de 0,383 da razão gordura das pernas/gordura total, muito acima da prevalência clínica estimada de lipedema, de 10 a 12%; como o NHANES não teve avaliação clínica de lipedema, isso indica que o ponto de corte, aplicado fora de um contexto clínico caso-controle, capta sobretudo um padrão ginoide mais amplo e não o lipedema. USO COMO MARCADOR SUBSTITUTO: análises do NHANES com fenótipos semelhantes ao lipedema definidos por DXA relatam HOMA-IR menor (44,2%) e menor prevalência de diabetes (OR 0,21), mas são marcadores exploratórios e não validados, que descrevem uma distribuição de gordura e não lipedema diagnosticado. Outros estudos usam a DXA apenas de forma descritiva (um relato de caso; um estudo com 40 pacientes sobre cinesiofobia, sem diferença de massa gorda). Os pontos de corte vêm de estudos de centro único e não foram validados externamente contra o diagnóstico clínico.
question.bottom_line: A body-composition scan (DXA) can measure how much fat sits in the legs compared with the rest of the body, and in clinic studies this helps tell women with lipedema apart from other women. It cannot diagnose lipedema on its own: in a large population survey more than half of women passed the usual leg-fat cutoff, so the number mostly flags a common hip-and-leg fat pattern and still needs a clinical exam.
question.bottom_line_pt: Um exame de composição corporal (DXA) consegue medir quanto da gordura fica nas pernas em comparação com o resto do corpo, e em estudos clínicos isso ajuda a distinguir mulheres com lipedema de outras mulheres. Ele não diagnostica lipedema sozinho: numa grande pesquisa populacional, mais da metade das mulheres ultrapassou o ponto de corte usual de gordura nas pernas, então esse número indica sobretudo um padrão comum de gordura em quadris e pernas e ainda exige exame clínico.
question.major_uncertainty: DXA cutoffs come from small single-centre case-control studies and have never been validated externally against clinical diagnosis; in the general population the 0.383 cutoff is met by 57% of women, so its specificity for lipedema outside the clinic is unknown and likely poor.
question.major_uncertainty_pt: Os pontos de corte da DXA vêm de pequenos estudos caso-controle de centro único e nunca foram validados externamente contra o diagnóstico clínico; na população geral, 57% das mulheres atingem o ponto de corte de 0,383, de modo que sua especificidade para lipedema fora do consultório é desconhecida e provavelmente baixa.

claims.statement: DXA regional fat indices, such as leg fat relative to total fat or a low trunk-to-leg fat ratio, may help discriminate lipedema from controls.
claims.statement_pt: Os índices regionais de gordura por DXA, como a gordura das pernas em relação à gordura total ou uma baixa razão entre gordura do tronco e das pernas, podem ajudar a discriminar o lipedema de controles.

context.population: women with lipedema vs healthy controls
context.exposure: leg fat mass/total fat mass index (DXA)

evidence.title: Body Composition Assessment by Dual-Energy X-Ray Absorptiometry: A Useful Tool for the Diagnosis of Lipedema
evidence.finding: Leg fat mass/total fat mass index distinguished lipedema from controls with AUC 0.90 (sensitivity 0.95, specificity 0.73 at cutoff 0.383) across BMI strata; lean mass and bone density did not differ.
evidence.quote: Leg FM/total FM (índice principal): AUC=0,90 (IC95% 0,86–0,94), melhor índice de Youden (0,68), sensibilidade=0,95, especificidade=0,73 para ponto de corte=0,383 — valores <0,383 permitem excluir lipedema com razoável grau de certeza

evidence.title: Lipedema: pathophysiological insights and therapeutic strategies — An update for dermatologists
evidence.finding: Dermatology review cites the DEXA leg-fat/total-fat ratio >=0.384 as suggesting lipedema and <0.383 as useful for exclusion, an auxiliary tool for borderline cases.
evidence.quote: DEXA index (Buso et al.): leg-fat/total-fat ratio ≥0.384 suggests lipedema; <0.383 useful for exclusion — auxiliary tool for borderline cases

evidence.title: Body composition in lipoedema of the legs using dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry: A case-control study
evidence.finding: Case-control DXA: BMI-adjusted leg fat ~1.3 times higher in lipedema across BMI categories; leg fat/BMI best discriminator (AUC 0.82, cutoff 0.4637, sensitivity 87%, specificity 68%); trunk fat/BMI and leg lean mass did not differ.
evidence.quote: AUC para gordura de pernas/IMC = 0,82 (IC95% 0,75–0,90) — melhor discriminador entre os indicadores testados Valor de corte ótimo: 0,4637 kg gordura de pernas/IMC — sensibilidade 87%, especificidade 68%

evidence.title: Dual-Energy X-Ray absorptiometry based differentiation of lipoedema and familial partial lipodystrophy from general obesity in women.
evidence.finding: In 72 women, lower trunk fat/leg fat ratio best distinguished lipedema from general obesity (AUC 0.964); total fat >=43.5% separated lipedema from familial partial lipodystrophy (AUC 0.990).
evidence.quote: Lipoedema was best distinguished by a lower trunk fat mass (FM)/leg FM ratio (AUC: 0.964; p < 0.001).

evidence.title: Distinct systemic metabolic signatures in premenopausal women with lipedema revealed by composite indices.
evidence.finding: Exploratory matched DXA subset (n=12): a composite fat distribution index differed between lipedema and BMI-matched controls (g=1.26; p<0.001), reflecting more peripheral fat.
evidence.quote: Regional body composition was additionally assessed in an exploratory matched DXA subset (n=12).

evidence.title: Lipedema: What we don’t know
evidence.finding: Narrative review cites DXA differentiation via leg-fat/total-fat index (cutoff 0.383) and BMI-adjusted leg fat (cutoff 0.46), noting no easy objective imaging test exists.
evidence.quote: Diagnóstico de imagem: ultrassom de alta resolução diferencia lipedema (espessura subcutânea aumentada) de linfedema (espessura dérmica aumentada + ecogenicidade reduzida)

claims.statement: Evidence on DXA and other imaging tools for lipedema remains limited, with small heterogeneous samples and poorly reported reliability.
claims.statement_pt: As evidências sobre DXA e outras ferramentas de imagem para o lipedema permanecem limitadas, com amostras pequenas e heterogêneas e confiabilidade mal relatada.

context.population: women with suspected or confirmed lipedema
context.exposure: multimodal imaging (ultrasound, lymphoscintigraphy, CT, MRI, MR lymphangiography, DXA)

evidence.title: Diagnostic imaging in lipedema: A systematic review
evidence.finding: Systematic review of 32 studies (1154 patients) lists DXA cutoffs (leg fat/BMI >=0.46, leg fat/total fat >=0.384) among imaging methods, but overall diagnostic performance was limited.
evidence.quote: The diagnostic performance of currently available imaging modalities for assessing lipedema is limited. Prospective studies are needed to evaluate and compare the diagnostic performance of each imaging modality.

evidence.title: Assessment Tools to Quantify the Physical Aspects of Lipedema: A Systematic Review
evidence.finding: Review of 13 quantification tools: heterogeneous, poorly documented protocols and rarely reported clinimetric reliability, from small heterogeneous cohorts, preventing recommendations.
evidence.quote: Reporte limitado de clinimetria, derivado de pequenas coortes em populações heterogêneas, impactou a capacidade de recomendar ferramentas para prática clínica e pesquisa. Investigações adicionais são necessárias para estabelecer validade e reliability de ferramentas de medição e imagem

claims.statement: A gynoid fat phenotype may mimic lipedema, so fat distribution alone may not reliably separate lipedema from gynoid obesity without clinical screening.
claims.statement_pt: Um fenótipo de gordura ginoide pode imitar o lipedema, de modo que a distribuição de gordura isoladamente pode não separar com confiabilidade o lipedema da obesidade ginoide sem triagem clínica.

context.population: women with obesity (android and gynoid phenotypes)

evidence.title: Dor crônica e biomarcadores inflamatórios em mulheres com obesidade: Impacto dos Fenótipos Adiposos e Lipedema
evidence.finding: Narrative review: a gynoid phenotype can mimic lipedema, and lack of systematic lipedema screening compromises interpretation of pain-inflammation data in women with obesity.
evidence.quote: Fenótipo ginoide pode simular lipedema — ausência de triagem sistemática compromete a interpretabilidade dos dados de dor-inflamação

evidence.title: Peripheral fat distribution, the lipedema-associated phenotype, and lower prevalence of cardiometabolic disease in women: a cross-sectional study (NHANES 2011-2018)
evidence.finding: In NHANES women aged 20-59, 57% met the DXA Buso criterion (leg/total fat ≥0.383), far above the estimated 10-12% clinical lipedema prevalence; the authors infer the criterion mostly identifies a broader gynoid fat pattern without clinical lipedema. NHANES had no clinical lipedema assessment.
evidence.quote: 57% of the women in the sample met the Buso criterion, a proportion substantially higher than the estimated clinical prevalence of lipedema, approximately 10-12%, and the estimated prevalence of 12.3% among Brazilian women.7,17 This discrepancy suggests that, when applied to the general population, the criterion predominantly identifies women without clinical lipedema and seems to capture a broader pattern of gynoid fat distribution, of which the clinical and symptomatic lipedema phenotype may represent a subset.

claims.statement: DXA regional fat measures are used in lipedema studies as descriptive variables or as proxy definitions of a lipedema-like phenotype.
claims.statement_pt: As medidas regionais de gordura por DXA são usadas em estudos de lipedema como variáveis descritivas ou como definições substitutas de um fenótipo semelhante ao do lipedema.

context.outcome: regional fat masses and android-to-gynoid fat ratio

evidence.title: JCEM Case Reports, 2026, 4, luag018
evidence.finding: Case report: DXA assessed total, trunk, leg and arm fat masses and android-to-gynoid ratio in a lipedema patient, alongside MRI regional volumes.
evidence.quote: Total body, trunk, leg and arm fat masses, the android-to-gynoid fat ratio (in general, the android region is the area between the lower ribs and the pelvis and the gynoid region is the area below the pelvis to the upper thighs) and fat-free mass were assessed by using dual-energy X-ray absorptiomet

evidence.title: Unveiling kinesiophobia: A hidden challenge
evidence.finding: In 40 lipedema patients, DXA lower-extremity fat mass did not differ between high and low kinesiophobia groups.
evidence.quote: the lipedema patients were evaluated in terms of extremity volumes, and total and mean lower extremity fat mass by dualenergy X-ray absorptiometry

evidence.title: The Lipedema Phenotype is Inversely Associated with Celiac Disease Autoimmunity: Testing the Immunological Shield Hypothesis in NHANES
evidence.finding: In NHANES women, a lipedema-like phenotype defined by DXA leg-to-trunk fat ratio >90th percentile had 44.2% lower HOMA-IR (p<0.001); exploratory, unvalidated proxy.
evidence.quote: HOMA-IR mediano 44,2% menor no fenótipo lipedema (1,35 [IQR 0,95–2,01] vs 2,42 [IQR 1,47–4,30]; p<0,001)

evidence.title: Exploring the Immunological Shield Hypothesis: A Population-Based Exploration of Phenotypic Divergence Between Lipedema and Celiac Disease Autoimmunity
evidence.finding: The same DXA-defined lipedema-like phenotype was associated with lower diabetes prevalence (1.8% vs 8.1%; OR 0.21) in an exploratory population analysis.
evidence.quote: fenótipo lipedema fortemente protetor contra diabetes (prevalência 1,8% vs 8,1%; OR 0,21; IC95% 0,08-0,51; p<0,001)

change.summary: This update added one NHANES 2011-2018 study of 4,986 women (J Vasc Bras 2026), counted once, showing that 57% of women met the 0.383 leg/total fat cutoff, which strengthens the caution that the cutoff alone captures a broad gynoid pattern rather than diagnosed lipedema.
change.summary_pt: Esta atualização acrescentou um estudo do NHANES 2011-2018 com 4.986 mulheres (J Vasc Bras 2026), contado uma única vez, mostrando que 57% das mulheres atingiam o ponto de corte de 0,383 da razão gordura das pernas/gordura total, o que reforça a ressalva de que o ponto de corte isolado capta um padrão ginoide amplo e não lipedema diagnosticado.
change.population_pt: 4.986 mulheres de 20 a 59 anos no NHANES 2011–2018.
change.outcome: Proportion meeting the DXA leg-to-total fat threshold.
change.outcome_pt: Proporção que atingiu o ponto de corte da razão gordura das pernas/gordura total na DXA.
